title: Discovering Phase Space Structure in Learned Hamiltonian Systems
abstract: arXiv:2509.23003v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mechanics-inspired neural dynamical models improve interpretability and physical consistency, but they usually assume a known configuration space, fixed physical parameters, and deterministic prediction from a prescribed initial condition. We introduce Structured Phase Space GAN (SPS-GAN), a conditional generative model that learns structured dynamics from both Cartesian trajectories and video. SPS-GAN combines a port-Hamiltonian backbone with adversarial conditional generation, allowing conservative, dissipative, and forced systems to be represented in a single architecture. To infer latent mechanical structure from raw observations, we use a cyclic-coordinate loss that recovers both the system degrees of freedom and canonical coordinates without access to the true phase space. Experiments on simulated and real-world systems show that SPS-GAN improves trajectory accuracy over supervised dynamics baselines and video consistency

translated_title: 发现学习到的哈密顿系统中的相空间结构
translated_abstract: 力学启发的神经动力学模型提升了可解释性和物理一致性，但它们通常假设构型空间已知、物理参数固定，并且从给定初始条件出发进行确定性预测。我们提出结构化相空间生成对抗网络（SPS-GAN），这是一种条件生成模型，能够同时从笛卡尔轨迹和视频中学习结构化动力学。SPS-GAN 将端口哈密顿骨干网络与对抗式条件生成相结合，使保守系统、耗散系统和受迫系统能够在单一架构中得到表示。为了从原始观测中推断潜在的力学结构，我们采用循环坐标损失，在无需访问真实相空间的情况下同时恢复系统的自由度和正则坐标。在模拟系统和真实世界系统上的实验表明，SPS-GAN 在轨迹精度上优于监督动力学基线方法，并提升了视频一致性。
tldr: 提出 SPS-GAN 条件生成模型，将端口哈密顿网络与对抗生成相结合，可从轨迹和视频中统一学习保守、耗散及受迫系统的结构化动力学，并通过循环坐标损失在无需真实相空间的情况下恢复系统的自由度和正则坐标。
en_tdlr: SPS-GAN is a conditional generative model combining a port-Hamiltonian backbone with adversarial generation that learns structured conservative, dissipative, and forced dynamics from trajectories and video, while a cyclic-coordinate loss recovers degrees of freedom and canonical coordinates without access to the true phase space.
